node.statement: For d_j>=1, Sigma_j={0,...,d_j-1}^2 is finite and nonempty, p_js=d_j^(-2) is nonnegative, and its d_j^2 values sum to one. The formula U_j(a,b)e_j[k]=omega_j^(a*k)e_j[k+b mod d_j], omega_j=exp(2*pi*i/d_j), sends the chosen orthonormal basis bijectively to an orthonormal basis, so every U_j(a,b) is unitary.
